description: 10 team-authored eval cases: 5 single-turn + 5 multi-turn. Tests new tools, edge cases, and scenarios not covered by base eval.

cases.query: Thời tiết hôm nay ở Hà Nội thế nào?

metadata.what_it_tests: Weather query for a specific city → weather tool, not lookup.

cases.query: Tóm tắt đoạn văn sau: AI research in 2025 saw rapid advances in multimodal models, with companies releasing increasingly capable systems. OpenAI and Google both launched new versions of their flagship models. Key developments included improved reasoning capabilities and better tool use.

metadata.what_it_tests: User provides long text and asks for summary → summarize tool.

cases.query: What's the weather in London in Fahrenheit?

metadata.what_it_tests: Weather query with non-default units → weather tool with units=fahrenheit.
Weather query without specifying units → weather tool, not lookup. Units default to celsius.

cases.query: Tóm tắt giúp mình: GPT-5 is the latest model from OpenAI with improved reasoning. Claude 4 from Anthropic focuses on safety.

metadata.what_it_tests: Summarize routing: user provides text and asks for summary → summarize tool, not lookup.

turns.content: Cho mình nhiệt độ Seoul thôi, tính bằng độ F

metadata.what_it_tests: Multi-turn weather: carry city context, override to Seoul, switch units to fahrenheit on latest turn.

turns.content: Mọi người đang nói gì về thời tiết trên Twitter?
Thôi bỏ Twitter, cho mình hỏi thời tiết Đà Nẵng hôm nay.
Đúng rồi, thời tiết Đà Nẵng.

metadata.what_it_tests: Multi-turn: user switches from social_search to weather, tool must change accordingly on latest turn.

turns.content: À nhầm, tìm giúp tin AI hôm nay.
Tin AI trong ngày hôm nay nhé.

metadata.what_it_tests: Multi-turn: first turn out-of-scope (refuse), second turn corrects to legit request, third turn confirms. Must call lookup.

turns.content: Thời tiết Hà Nội thế nào?
Nhiệt độ Huế thôi, độ F

metadata.what_it_tests: Multi-turn weather: carry city context from first turn, switch to Hue, then change units to fahrenheit.

turns.content: Thời tiết hôm nay ở các thành phố: Hà Nội, Tokyo, London.
Nhiệt độ London tính bằng độ F nhé.

metadata.what_it_tests: Multi-turn: first turn asks multiple cities, second narrows to London, third adds fahrenheit units.
